```{r}

```

```{r}

```


```{r}
my_list2 <- list(
  x = c(3,7), 
  y = 1:3, 
  z = list(
    23, 
    c(1.25, 9.4), 
    zz = list(
      b = list("a", "q"), 
      aa = list(2, 2.3),
      c = 4:10
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
str(my_list2)
```

```{r}
my_list2$z$zz |> pluck("aa") |> list_c() |>  unlist()
```

Map can find lists in list in one level down as pluck

```{r}
my_list2$z |> map("aa") |> list_c() |> unlist()
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
my_list2$z$zz |> chuck("aa")
```

```{r}
my_list2 <- list(
  x = c(3, 7),
  y = 1:3,
  z = list(
    23, 
    c(1.25, 9.4), 
           zz = list(
             b = 1:3,
             aa = list(2, 2.3)
             )
           )
  )
```


```{r}
find_name <- function(x, target) {
  if (!is.list(x)) return(NULL)
  hit <- x[names(x) %in% target]
  deeper <- x |>
    # recursive
    purrr::map(find_name, target = target) |>
    purrr::compact() |>
    purrr::list_flatten(name_spec = "{outer}.{inner}")
  
  c(hit, deeper) |> 
    list_c() |>  
    unlist()
}
```

```{r}
my_list2 |> find_name("aa")

```
